verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right banner order (can, headline, CTA) with the subline on one line. Its flaws: the can is shrunk to a small, low-detail icon close to the left edge, the subline is tiny at banner size, and the SOLSTICE logo floats above the headline with little spacing. B's 'Solstice' headline runs into the Explore Flavours button, a leftover dark panel rectangle with a visible edge sits awkwardly behind the text, and the subline breaks to leave 'longest day.' as an orphan.
